commits.subject: Fix bmpload issues (#1743)
commits.reason: BMP/ICO loader hardening (GHSA-c4f2-mxv4-6fp5): bound width, height and pixel area before row-size arithmetic, reject INT32_MIN height, replace strip-geometry assertions with errors, validate the ICO BMP header length and palette size, check palette writes, keep partial reads at EOF and bound blob sizes. The pre-existing ICO size macro already had parentheses; local g_free cleanup is retained. Upstream fixture files are recreated in code from their headers; the deleted integration test maps to the existing bpp regression.
evidence: Unpatched code: 10 of 11 new BMP/ICO cases failed; overflowing widths and INT32_MIN height were accepted, a 100000x100000 header made ASAN abort on a 28 GiB allocation, and a 1000001-row bottom-up BMP aborted the process on g_assert. The bpp=40 case was already rejected (60d367c).
Patched: Go 1.27 build/vet/Staticcheck, go test ./... and Clang ASAN ICO/BMP tests passed; source lock regenerated against the v4.0.17 baseline.

commits.subject: v4.0.21
commits.reason: Release metadata and dependency updates; native builds deliberately deferred (decision 2026-11-03), not a claim that every update is irrelevant. Go module changes affect removed cloud/telemetry code; go-xmp is unchanged. libjpeg-turbo 3.2.1: not reachable; libvips uses only the classic libjpeg API, and the fixes are in TurboJPEG, jpegtran, jpeg_crop_scanline/skip_scanlines or API misuse. fribidi 1.0.18: the out-of-bounds write and unchecked allocations are in functions Pango does not call; the reachable quadratic-time case is bounded by the 14-column watermark text cap (899d7e6). lcms2 2.20: reachable through embedded ICC profiles, risk accepted because source images are maintained by the operator. aom 3.15.3: encoder only (dav1d decodes AVIF); multithreaded AVIF encoding of operator-maintained images, risk accepted. Revisit lcms2 and aom if source images can come from untrusted parties, and on the next Alpine package updates.
evidence: Library linkage and imported symbols checked in Alpine 3.23 vips; libheif v1.23.7 plugin priorities checked (dav1d 150, aom decoder 100); see CHANGE.md v4.0.21.
